title: Warm Rolled Croissant
description: Original static low-poly croissant with a continuous plump dough body, dominant central rolled sheet, progressively smaller side shoulders and long tapered crescent tips. Three closed upper dough layers genuinely attach to the body; the central narrowing sheet wraps down the inner arc and ends beneath the pastry. Separate serving plate. Same asset ID visual redesign v2, with changed proportions and presentation plate size; not a new unique type. Editable source and static GLB components; no cooking or dough simulation.
